summary.zh: 不只离开危险区，也能在正确瞬间穿过攻击。
summary.en: Avoid damage by timing a brief safe window, not only by moving away.

rules.zh: 闪避动作在部分时间内不受特定伤害，动作结束后仍可能落在危险位置。玩家需要同时判断按键时机、移动方向和落点，反馈来自擦身而过与反击窗口。
rules.en: An evasive action grants a limited window against certain damage. Its destination can still be unsafe, so the player must judge timing, direction and landing position together.

decisions.zh: 向外撤退更安全，穿过敌人可能更快进入背后反击位置。
decisions.en: Retreating can be safer; passing through an enemy can reach a faster counterattack position.

decisions.zh: 连续闪避能脱险，却可能把自己送进下一组危险。
decisions.en: Repeated evasions can escape one threat while moving into the next.

effect.zh: 占比增大会降低精确时机要求，但落点仍可保持挑战。
effect.en: A larger fraction reduces timing difficulty while landing hazards can preserve challenge.

effect.zh: 更长冷却迫使玩家预判，短冷却适合密集弹幕。
effect.en: Long cooldowns demand anticipation; short ones support dense projectile patterns.

contrast.zh: 《哈迪斯》重视俯视空间中的连续位移；《死亡细胞》还让同一动作兼任穿过敌人和钻洞。
contrast.en: Hades emphasizes chaining movement across a top-down arena; Dead Cells also uses the action to pass enemies and enter low passages.

combination.zh: 设计提案：让安全落点激活短时压力板，闪避不仅用于保命，还决定下一次环境连锁的起点。
combination.en: Design proposal: make a safe dodge landing activate a short-lived pressure plate, turning evasion into the start of an environmental chain.

setup.zh: 一道横扫正在逼近，你背后是墙，敌人身后有空位。
setup.en: A sweeping attack approaches; a wall is behind you and space is behind the enemy.

action.zh: 你迎着攻击翻滚，在短暂无伤时段穿过横扫。
action.en: Roll toward the attack and pass through it during the brief protected interval.

result.zh: 横扫没有造成伤害，但翻滚结束的位置决定你是否会挨下一击。
result.en: The sweep misses, but your landing position determines exposure to the next strike.

next.zh: 从新位置选择反击或继续拉开距离。
next.en: Choose whether to counter or create more distance from the new position.

firstStep.zh: 用一个圆形角色、一种横扫和可显示的闪避保护时段做测试场。
firstStep.en: Use a simple character, one sweeping attack, and a visible dodge-protection interval.

pitfall.zh: 先解决角色碰撞与落点，避免玩家明明躲过攻击却卡在敌人身体里。
pitfall.en: Resolve collision and landing before adding attacks, so successful dodges do not trap players inside enemies.

test.zh: 观察玩家是否同时改变翻滚时机和方向，而非只反复按闪避。
test.en: Check whether players adjust both timing and direction instead of repeatedly pressing dodge.
